Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine to work with — files, chats, jobs and my own accounts all live here under /home/bia.

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). On the first visit you take the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you'd like that.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — I can sign up for e-mail and other things in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read the brief: I look after Sarah's calendar (working hours Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00, nothing outside them) and her messages, and I have Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) as a contact — he's just connected too.

What would you like to start with?

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm alvarez-agent, your assistant on this computer. I look after your calendar and messages: working hours Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00, and I keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date with a log of every booking, decline and deletion.

I've read next week's schedule (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) and I'm ready to give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 slot in it.

One thing I'm missing: my name and gender aren't set yet — should I stay alvarez-agent, and male, female or neutral?

On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) proposing 30-minute slots in next week's free gaps: Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. I'll book as soon as he picks one.
Understood — I'll take care of it myself and pick a slot that fits your week. I'll book it in CALENDAR.md, log the change, and tell you the time when it's settled.
Sarah's assistant asked for her 1:1 — booked **Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30** (free slot, inside working hours) and logged it in CALENDAR.md. Ready for the next student.

Understood — I'll handle the scheduling on my own judgement this week: every student who asks gets a free 30-minute slot inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, first come first served, and I'll log each booking. I'll keep you posted here.

Done: Professor Alvarez offered Monday 10:00-10:30 and it works, so I booked it. **Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 — 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**, inside working hours and free in your calendar; it sits right after Reading group, before Focus: CSE452 lab. Logged in CALENDAR.md as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`, and I've confirmed with him. I'll also give you a nudge that morning.
Also set a reminder for Mon Nov 23 at 09:45 so you're not caught out by it.
